# Rkkp Afdk

This wiki documents the clinical quality, epidemiological tracking, and operational governance of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) under the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP). Synthesized from the 2023 and 2024 annual reports, it maps the entire infrastructure of atrial fibrillation care in Denmark—from national registries and regional health clusters to specific anticoagulant therapies, risk scoring systems, and clinical quality indicators. Every entity, topic, and comparative analysis is traceable to the original source documents, providing a comprehensive, citation-backed resource for understanding cardiovascular healthcare quality and patient outcomes across Danish regions.

## Start Here

- [[topics/clinical-indicators/index|Clinical Indicators]] — Diagnostic, monitoring, and adverse event metrics used to evaluate atrial fibrillation care and cardiological outcomes.
- [[entities/organizations/index|Organizations]] — The multi-tiered organizational backbone of the Danish healthcare system, encompassing national health authorities, regional administrations, and hospitals.
- [[comparisons/index|Comparisons]] — Detailed comparative analyses of clinical quality indicators, patient demographics, and treatment outcomes across Danish regions.
- [[topics/epidemiology/index|Epidemiology]] — National incidence, prevalence, and demographic profiles of atrial fibrillation in Denmark.
